constructor: (config:GKTKernelConfig, binding:GKTBinding, adjacency:Tensor, *, recipe_id, mlp_hidden_dim, normalization, dropout, initial_state_policy, gru_variant)
network: Registered concept/interaction Embeddings; three independent Linear-ELU-Linear-ELU MLPs with explicit width and biases; EA two affine gates; six bias-free ChoGRU affines; shared readout weight/per-node bias; fixed adjacency buffer plus existing StaticGKTKernel.
erase_add: m*(1-sigmoid(W_e*m+b_e))+tanh(W_a*m+b_a); declared DKVMN specialization M_old=v=m,w=1, NOT author fact
sparse_update: where(event_valid AND (answered OR incoming/outgoing nonzero support),g,old_h), AFTER GRU
state: GKTRecurrentState(values[B,N,H],history_counts[B],binding,graph_sha256,recipe_sha256); caller tensors never mutated, no implicit learner cache
causality: sequence predicts query_t from H_t before observe(i_t,r_t); output masks padded scores to finite0 and preserves state; unknown active IDs/multiconcept reject; no OOV or calibration adoption
tests: Hand-calculated EA and non-diagonal-reset GRU; asymmetric directions; sparse mask positivecontrol; sequence==step/prefix/current-future answer invariance; two-learner isolation/permutation; padding/empty sequence; immutable inputs; binding/domain/node/graph mismatches; every registered parameter path finite nonzero gradients; 0 optimizer.
